notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.muteNotificationsHint: Stop notification toasts from popping up. Important actions like incoming calls still show.
notifications.notificationSoundHint: Play a sound for incoming calls and toasts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account and the servers you belong to.
settings.emailReadOnlyHint: Contact support to change the email on your account.
settings.changePasswordSuccess: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.
settings.logoutConfirmDescription: You'll need to log back in to use Concord on this device again.
settings.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all of your data.
settings.deleteAccountConsequences: You'll be logged out of every device immediately. Your account will be deactivated for 30 days - if you log back in during that time, the deletion is cancelled and your account is restored. After 30 days, it's permanently deleted and can't be recovered.
settings.deleteAccountSuccessToastDescription: Log back in within 30 days to cancel the deletion.

sessions.revokeConfirmDescription: This device will be signed out immediately.
sessions.revokeAllOthersConfirmDescription: Every other device signed into your account will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
sessions.noOtherSessions: No other devices are signed in.

privacy.title: Privacy & Safety
privacy.friendRequests: Who can send you friend requests
privacy.readReceiptsHint: Let others see when you've read their messages.

voice.title: Voice & Video
voice.speaker: Speaker
voice.permissionDenied: Permission denied - check your browser settings.
voice.noPermissionYet: Grant microphone/camera access to see your devices.
voice.screenShareUnsupportedDescription: Your browser doesn't support screen sharing.

messages.forwardDescription: Choose where to send this message.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search messages across your channels and conversations.

desktopNotifications.title: Desktop Notifications
desktopNotifications.hint: Show a system notification for messages, calls, and friend requests while this tab isn't focused.
desktopNotifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Enable them in your browser settings to use this.

servers.editServerDescription: Update this server's name and icon.
servers.iconHint: Optional. PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to 5 MB.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Manage roles and permissions for {{server}}.
roles.name: Role name
roles.noSelectionDescription: Pick a role on the left to review or change what it can do.
roles.defaultRoleHint: Applies to every member. It cannot be renamed or deleted, but its permissions set the baseline for the whole server.
roles.readOnlyHint: You need the Manage Roles permission to change roles on this server.
roles.outrankedHint: This role ranks at or above your highest role, so you cannot change it.
roles.reservedHint: Reserved for an upcoming release - not enforced yet.

permissionHint.ViewChannels: See channels and read their history.
permissionHint.SendMessages: Post messages, and edit or delete their own.
permissionHint.ManageServer: Rename the server and change its icon.
permissionHint.ManageRoles: Create, edit, and assign roles below their own.
permissionHint.KickMembers: Remove members, who may rejoin with an invite.
permissionHint.BanMembers: Remove members and block them from rejoining.
permissionHint.Speak: Transmit audio and video in voice channels.
permissionHint.Administrator: Grants every permission. Assign with care.

moderation.reasonOptional: Optional - shown in the ban and timeout list.
moderation.timeoutDescription: They will not be able to send messages or speak in voice until the timeout expires.
moderation.banDescription: They will be removed from the server, disconnected from voice, and blocked from rejoining with any invite.
moderation.noBansDescription: Nobody is currently banned from this server.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.enabledDescription: Your account is protected by an authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabledDescription: Add a second step to your sign-in using an authenticator app.
twoFactor.scanInstruction: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication
twoFactor.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.disableDescription: This removes the second step from your sign-in. Your password and a current code are both required.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: This invalidates your existing codes and issues ten new ones.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Use one of these if you lose access to your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryWarning: Save these now - they are shown once and cannot be retrieved later. Each works only once.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Could not copy - select and copy the codes manually.

qrLogin.showCode: Sign in with a QR code
qrLogin.hint: Approve from a device where you are already signed in.
qrLogin.qrAlt: QR code for signing in on this device
qrLogin.orEnterCode: Or enter this code on your other device:
qrLogin.expired: That code expired before it was approved.
qrLogin.startFailed: Couldn't start a QR sign-in. Try again.
qrLogin.approveSubtitle: Confirm the device asking to sign in to your account.
qrLogin.approveWarning: Only approve this if you started the sign-in yourself. Approving signs that device in to your account.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.subtitle: Site-wide stats and account management.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username, or email…
admin.cannotDisableSelf: You can't disable your own account
admin.disableDescription: This immediately signs them out everywhere and blocks future sign-ins until re-enabled.
admin.noReportsDescription: There are no reports matching this filter.

reports.reportMessageDescription: Tell moderators what's wrong with it. They'll be able to see who sent it and its content.
reports.reportUserDescription: Tell moderators what's wrong. They'll see your report along with this person's basic profile info.
reports.reasonHint: Required - describe why you're reporting this.
